sections.markdown:
## B — Audience, level and prerequisites: pedestrians, school buses, emergency vehicles and traffic stops
Audience: first-time North Carolina applicants preparing for the regular Class C knowledge test, in English; the school bus road-layout rules [A03] and the move-over law [A04] are classic test material.
Level: rule application by situation; learners must map a road layout or vehicle type to the right action, so scenario drills matter more than recall.
Prerequisites: the occupant protection section, whose pickup-bed rule continues at the top of this range, and basic right-of-way vocabulary.
Sensitivity: the traffic-stop guidance is stated as printed; the dossier gives no legal advice about rights during police encounters.

corpus_stability.reason: The handbook prints a single revision date (Revised May 2025) on its back cover and states laws and fees are subject to change by the General Assembly; no sign of more than one revision per year in the selected pages.
